title: Monotonicity of the Gowers norm
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $k$ be a positive integer, and let $f\colon\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb R$. Define $\|f\|_{U^j}$ as the $2^j$-th root of $\mathbb E_{x,y_1,\ldots,y_j}\prod_{s\in\mathbb F_2^j}f(x+\sum_{i=1}^j s_i y_i)$, with the average uniform over $x,y_1,\ldots,y_j\in\mathbb F_2^n$. Then $\|f\|_{U^k}\leq\|f\|_{U^{k+1}}$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on $\mathbb F_2^n$
